questions.name: Call Volume Over Time
questions.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at) AS day, count(*) AS calls FROM calls GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.name: Average QA Score by Agent
questions.sql: SELECT c.agent_ext, round(avg(q.overall_score), 1) AS avg_score, count(*) AS calls_scored FROM qa_scores q JOIN calls c ON c.call_id = q.call_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.name: Flagged Calls (Needs Review)
questions.sql: SELECT c.call_id, c.agent_ext, c.started_at, q.overall_score, q.notes FROM qa_scores q JOIN calls c ON c.call_id = q.call_id WHERE q.flagged = true ORDER BY c.started_at DESC

questions.name: Real-time Assist Trigger Frequency
questions.sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS hour, count(*) AS prompts FROM realtime_prompts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
